note: Butterfield's retail schedule of charges for Bermuda (January 2026): its Mastercard Standard or Visa Classic costs 75 dollars a year for the primary card, at an annual interest rate of 20.50%. Clarien Bank's fee schedule (effective 8 November 2024): its Visa Platinum costs 85 dollars a year, at 21.00% a year on merchandise; the 22.75% on cash advances isn't written.
